name: ThemeEffectScheme
description: Represents the effects scheme of a Microsoft Office theme.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the ThemeEffectScheme object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the ThemeEffectScheme object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the ThemeEffectScheme object. Read-only.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the effects scheme of a Microsoft Office theme from a file.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The name of the effect scheme file.
